C'est desormais le segment d'operations poursuivies de Global Payments apres la cession d'Issuer Solutions a FIS en janvier 2026. Valeurs annuelles verbatim des 10-K (Note Segment Information).

kpis.signal: Traitement pour emetteurs de cartes : 2,48 Mds $ en 2024, activite cedee a FIS en janvier 2026.

Activite cedee a FIS en janvier 2026 et presentee depuis en operations abandonnees ; dernier exercice publie en segment = 2024. Valeurs annuelles verbatim des 10-K (Note Segment Information).

kpis.signal: Resultat operationnel du segment a 2,74 Mds $ en 2025, en hausse grace aux economies de couts.
kpis.description: Resultat operationnel du segment Merchant Solutions (revenus du segment moins charges directes, hors corporate, depreciation de goodwill et cessions). Valeurs annuelles verbatim des 10-K (Note Segment Information).

kpis.signal: Marge operationnelle du segment a 35,5 % en 2025, en progression continue depuis 2021.
kpis.description: Marge operationnelle du segment Merchant Solutions (resultat operationnel du segment divise par ses revenus). 2025 et 2024 verbatim des 10-K (35,5 % et 34,0 %) ; annees anterieures calculees a partir des revenus et resultats operationnels du segment publies dans les 10-K.

company_description: Global Payments Inc. provides payment technology and software solutions for card, check, and digital-based payments in the Americas, Europe, and the Asia-Pacific. It offers authorization, settlement and funding, customer support, chargeback resolution, reconciliation and dispute management, terminal rental, sales and deployment, payment security, and consolidated billing and reporting services. The company also provides an array of enterprise software solutions that streamline business operations of its customers in various vertical markets; and value-added solutions and services, such as point-of-sale software, analytics and customer engagement, payroll and reporting, and human capital management. It markets its products and services through direct sales force, trade associations, agent and enterprise software providers, referral arrangements with value-added resellers, independent sales organizations, payment facilitators, and financial institutions. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
